When attempting to request the fcr:backup feature on a specific resource, an ambiguous is returned:
> 400: The namespace prefix (fcr) has not been registered
This error message should instead indicate that backup must be performed on the root of the repository.

comments.body:
Andrew Woods Please see A. Soroka comment in https://github.com/fcrepo4/fcrepo4/pull/969#discussion_r49653062
I am not sure why this ticket is relevant to FedoraExport?

Waiting for your comments. Thanks!

We should also test the following scenario, and potentially create another related ticket, if it is not addressed in the current work:

I am trying to run export request like this -  http://fedoradev0.icpsr.umich.edu:8097/fedora/rest/system/fcr:export/recurse=true&skipBinary=false and system reports error with message "Prefix fcr has not been registered".

See: https://groups.google.com/d/msg/fedora-tech/KcEezVBG8pw/0DvUCRqyCgAJ

Andrew Woods See https://wiki.duraspace.org/display/FF/2016-07-21+-+Fedora+Tech+Meeting

fcr:backup/ fcr:restore will not in future API specification.

I believe this ticket can be closed.

renderedFields.description:
When attempting to request the fcr:backup feature on a specific resource, an ambiguous is returned:
curl -X POST "http://localhost:8080/fedora/rest/test/fcr:backup"
> 400: The namespace prefix (fcr) has not been registered

This error message should instead indicate that backup must be performed on the root of the repository.
